svg.title: Three partition keys, good and bad
svg.desc: The serverless NoSQL account …-cosmos holds the database shop with three containers. orders is partitioned by /customerId, many values that spread reads and writes evenly; events by the hierarchical key /tenantId then /userId, so a large tenant can pass one logical partition's 20 GB; bykey-status by /status, only a handful of values, so one hot partition takes the writes.
